Indicator: Percentage compliance with statutory prescripts
Outcome: Priority 5: Spatial Integration, Human Settlements and Local Government
Cluster: Governance and Administration cluster
Target_Q1: 100% compliance with statutory  prescripts
ActualOutput_Q1: 60% compliance with statutory prescripts.
ReasonforDeviation_Q1:
Failure to provide requisite Draft Replies in accordance with the 10-Day Rule and delay in providing additional information to some of the Draft Replies. For instance, five Draft Replies were returned by the Ministry requiring additional information, however the responsible Manager despite several reminders, took longer than the prescribed time frame to provide the required information/amended Draft Reply.

Payments were made after 30 days due to insufficient internal controls.
CorrectiveAction_Q1:
To continue to enforce the implementation of the approved Standard Operating Procedures for Parliamentary Questions in order to ensure compliance with the 10-Day Rule for submission of requisite Draft Replies for approval and submission to the Ministry, thereafter tabling in Parliament.

Assessment is underway to determine accountability for the late payment of invoice and if found negligent will be dealt with in terms of prescripts and law.
Target_Q2: 100% compliance with statutory  prescripts
ActualOutput_Q2: 60% compliance with statutory prescripts

A number of Parliamentary Questions (PQs) required information that could only be sourced from provinces.

For July 2022, 8 invoices were paid after 30 days because there was a delay in processing the payments due to the payment being captured incorrectly and had to be reversed to correct the error.
CorrectiveAction_Q2:
In addition to the continued implementation of the approved SOP, the unit is now dealing directly with external bodies such as municipalities and provinces in order to improve turnaround times for the provision of the required information. The approach is starting to yield positive results.

Investigations is underway to determine accountability for the late payment of invoice and if found negligent will be dealt with in terms of prescripts and law

CorrectiveAction_Q3: Enhance communication with Provinces and Municipalities to submit information on responses to Parliamentary questions timeously  in line with the SOP.
